cardmember_claim.text: I ordered a pair of headphones on 14 June and they never turned up. I waited three weeks. I contacted the seller twice through their website contact form and got one reply saying it was delivered, but nothing has arrived at my apartment. I've checked with the building manager and there's no parcel. I want this charge reversed.
